p: sent to Jobab king of Madon: The more God's power appears, the more the wicked rage against it.
Chinneroth: Which the evangelists call the lake of Gennesaret, or Tiberias.
Hermon in the land of Mizpeh: Which was mount Sion, as in De 4:48.
hough their horses: That neither they should serve to the use of war, nor the Israelites should put their trust in them.
Misrephothmaim: Which signifies hot waters, or according to some, brine pits.
souls that were therein with the: Both men, women and children.
strength: Which were strong by situation and not hurt by war.
man they smote with the edge: All mankind.
mountain of Israel: That is, Samaria.
Halak: So called, because it was bare and without trees.
harden their hearts: That is, to give them over to themselves: and therefore they could not but rebel against God and seek their own destruction.
in Gath: Out of which came Goliath, 1Sa 17:4.
